description: Add separate things.todo.complete, things.todo.cancel, and things.todo.reopen actions for current non-recurring Task6 to-dos. Enforce valid source-state transitions, set or clear the stop timestamp correctly, reject no-op transitions, and reject project, heading, deleted, trashed, legacy, recurring, or incomplete targets. Use guarded prepare and commit, safe previews, exact freshness checks, delivery certainty, and fake-based regression tests.
title: Add guarded Things lifecycle actions
